---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

career_hr <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(career_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(career_hr)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    Batting |>
      group_by(playerID) |>
      summarise(first_year = min(yearID), last_year = max(yearID), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    full_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    full_name = factor(full_name, levels = rev(unique(full_name))),
    steroid_era = first_year <= 2009 & last_year >= 1994,
    steroid_era = if_else(steroid_era, "Active in steroid era", "Not active in steroid era")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_hr))

ggplot(career_hr, aes(x = career_hr, y = full_name, fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Active in steroid era" = "firebrick", "Not active in steroid era" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Career overlap with 1994–2009"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 career home run leaders by steroid-era overlap",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Batting dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

bonds <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  select(yearID, HR) |>
  arrange(yearID)

ggplot(bonds, aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds home runs by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Batting dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This page highlights the players with the most career home runs.
